items.text: Caleb Williams officially OUT for MNF vs PHI (hamstring); Tyson Bagent questionable after clearing steps/practicing. Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go MNF; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Official reports; Bagent full participant but Q; Barkley/Smith cleared post-stinger.
items.implication: Bears backup QB uncertainty tanks CHI offense; Eagles backs/WRs full go.
items.opportunity: Barkley/Smith full snaps MNF; monitor Bagent status for CHI pass catchers.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday Night vs DEN (hip/groin); ETR and reports indicate not expected to play, with potential Week 4 return.
items.why: No practice progress; McVay comments on lack of great progress; Rapoport not expected to play.
items.implication: Davante Adams elevated target/route share; avoid Nacua fantasy starts.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua historically; high volume SNF.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 3; confirmed across ETR list and beat reports.
items.why: Grade 1 hamstring; official OUT designation Friday.
items.implication: Houston WR/TE targets redistribute; Schultz primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% route target rate and 28% target share last week without Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow dislocation); not expected on IR, surgery not planned, Mariota starts; positive longer-term outlook for return ~Week 5-6.
items.why: Elbow dislocation Week 2; GM confirms no IR/surgery currently.
items.implication: Mariota start lowers WAS offense ceiling; McLaurin still viable but tougher SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: McLaurin 25% target share historically with Mariota.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe); Jaylen Warren expected to lead Steelers RB group per coach comments, with checkdown upside.
items.why: Toe injury; official OUT; RB coach: Warren will lead and stay fresh.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back; high volume vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + Rodgers checkdowns (vertical game struggling); Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Alec Pierce OUT and placed on IR (heel); Josh Downs target share jumped to 36% post-exit, now more perimeter routes.
items.why: Heel injury; official IR per Rapoport/Colts moves.
items.opportunity: Downs 36% target share after Pierce exit; perimeter usage up.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey listed IN (healthy enough); Jonah Coleman OUT/IR (high ankle), limiting Broncos depth but Dobbins/Harvey back.
items.why: Full participants; Coleman high-ankle to short-term IR (Schefter).
items.implication: Broncos RB committee resets with healthier Dobbins/Harvey; Coleman multi-week miss.
items.opportunity: Monitor snap split; prior Coleman 83% when Dobbins left.
items.conflict: Berry still long-term prefers Coleman H2.

items.text: With Dowdle out, projecting Jaylen Warren as clear lead back; vertical pass not working for Rodgers so expect heavy checkdowns to Warren. Practice squad Homer and rookie Heidenreich as backups. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in.
items.why: Coach: Warren leads group; stays fresh. ETR projects Qs (Warren/Evans/Bowers) in.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with volume + receiving work vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + zillion checkdowns; high snap share expected.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks placed on IR (core); Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead RB role (RB14 utilization through 2 weeks), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Core injury; only 5 games across 3 seasons; ETR lists OUT.
items.opportunity: Hubbard full workload; high utilization already.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Prior games without Nacua: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2. Projecting Qs including Evans/Bowers in.
items.why: Historical route/target data without Nacua; Nacua doubtful.
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside SNF vs DEN.

items.text: ETR projections live for main slate; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.why: Sim ceiling record; high opportunity in Lions offense.
items.implication: Elite weekly upside; prioritize in DFS/lineups.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush D; high prop.

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown (@PIT: 20+ touches/15% targets both games, RB7 util, PIT allows 5th-most RB rush yds); Chris Olave (vs LV: double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz (@IND: 28% tgt share sans Collins, IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Strong recent usage + favorable matchups; Collins out boosts Schultz.
items.opportunity: Brown high touches/targets; Olave air yards; Schultz route targets.

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara back); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest WR fantasy pts allowed, low ypr, WAS lowest implied total).
items.why: Poor recent usage/roles + tough matchups; Henderson out-touched Stevenson post-fumble (65% snaps).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson gap narrowing but Stevenson still ranked ahead short-term.
items.opportunity: Henderson positive outlook but not full takeover yet (pass pro concerns).
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN; usage still limited.
